submission.nextAction: Explain that the task will be read only by its task_id; do not promise image delivery until native bytes arrive.

continuation.nextAction: State whether the same task remains pending, the exact wait before its next same-task read, whether automatic polling has reached its deadline, or whether it has terminally failed.

reconciliation.nextAction: State that reconciliation_required was returned, ordinary polling stopped, the same task_id was retained, no replacement task was submitted, and no refund was inferred.

completion.nextAction: For n results, report delivered and missing zero-based indexes; success requires every requested item as native bytes.

conditionalFields.retry_after_seconds: Include only when the API returned HTTP 429 and a valid positive Retry-After value.
conditionalFields.api_error_code: Use only the exact public API error code explicitly returned by the API; otherwise write not returned.

failure.nextAction: Offer only an explicit new request or a same-task status/content read, according to the returned state.
